headline: A federal law renames a Veterans Affairs clinic in Hinesville, Georgia, after four named individuals.
what_it_does: This act changes the official name of the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Hinesville, Georgia. The clinic will now be called the John Gibson, Dan James, William Sapp, and Frankie Smiley VA Clinic. The law only changes the name and does not change clinic services, staffing, or hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 13, 2024.
